summary: Creekside kerb where cars park, but flats and houses sit 19-25 m opposite.

drivers.seclusion: Creek, palms and parkland behind the kerb; flats and houses 19-25 m away across a wide road.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed road wide enough for parked cars on this side; several cars parked in the imagery, so a van fits at the kerb.
drivers.traffic: Through road linking suburbs, but cars park along it so a van does not stand out.
drivers.convention: Cars park here, but one No Parking Any Time sign (left arrow) sits near the stretch; its extent is unclear.

flags: One No Parking Any Time sign near the stretch
Low-lying: 3.7-4.5 m elevation, Toowong Creek 15 m away
Homes 19-25 m away across the road
Flat: about 1% at the best section
sun_shade: Palms and trees shade the kerb from the north; open to afternoon sun from the west.
cannot_judge: Where the No Parking sign applies

best_section.where: North kerb of Indooroopilly Road beside the creek park, where cars are parked, opposite the garages
